prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE new production sprite atlas, whole-body walking rifle reload, 32 independent hand/gait states on a genuinely transparent alpha background.

Style reference only: the inspected standing-reload-v135.png shows an adult infantryman with realistic adult proportions, an olive-drab/khaki helmet, dark goggles, vest and magazine pouches, worn fatigues, gloves, kneepads and boots, carrying a dark M4-like rifle. Match its detailed gritty hand-painted raster/cel rendering, textured fabric folds, scuffed equipment, fine contours and dimensional painted shading. Create new walking poses; do not reuse its standing poses or layout. Not chibi, not flat vector.

PRODUCTION LAYOUT: exactly FOUR COLUMNS by EIGHT ROWS = 32 full-body cels. Portrait canvas with width:height 1:2, suggested 1536 x 3072, an invisible regular lattice of 384 x 384 cells. No visible grid. Each cel contains exactly one complete soldier facing RIGHT, helmet through both boots and the entire rifle visible. Same anatomical scale and stable grounded-foot baseline relative to every cell. Leave at least 24 pixels of fully transparent padding inside every cell on all four sides; helmets, boots, rifle and hands never touch the sheet edge or a neighboring cel. Keep all 32 figures equally scaled, comfortably contained, and evenly registered. All empty pixels are transparent, not a painted checkerboard.

ROWS, TOP TO BOTTOM: eight stages of ONE sequential magazine replacement. Each row uses its stated hand/magazine stage in ALL four columns:
1. Left hand reaching toward the magazine well.
2. Empty magazine halfway pulled downward from the well.
3. Empty magazine fully withdrawn; left hand moves toward the belt pouch.
4. Left hand at the belt pouch extracting a fresh magazine.
5. Fresh magazine lifted midway from the belt toward the well.
6. Fresh magazine inserted into the well.
7. Left hand finishing the slap/seat and working the bolt area.
8. Support hand returned to the fore-end, ready.
Right hand controls the rifle grip throughout. Rifle muzzle points forward/right or slightly downward throughout, never overhead. Make the changing hand positions and magazine states visually legible.

COLUMNS, LEFT TO RIGHT: four genuinely different walking phases in EVERY row:
A. LEFT leg forward, RIGHT leg rear with rear heel lifting.
B. Legs passing: RIGHT knee moving forward, LEFT boot planted.
C. RIGHT leg forward, LEFT leg rear with rear heel lifting.
D. Legs passing: LEFT knee moving forward, RIGHT boot planted.
Repeat the SAME corresponding column gait silhouettes down all eight rows while reload hand positions change. Distinguish near and far legs clearly. Natural adult WALKING with subtle but visible knee bends, clearly alternating legs, and at least one boot grounded in each cel; no running or airborne poses.

This is one generated sheet of independent hand/gait states: every cell combines its ROW's reload hand state with its COLUMN's gait state. It is NOT 32 sequential clones and must not repeat a frozen identical stride across columns.

Avoid: backgrounds, text, labels, numbers, gridlines, ground or cast shadows, baseplates, gun flashes, ropes or slings, raised-arm commands, cropped bodies, cropped weapons, missing rows, extra rows, extra columns, extra figures, oversized heads, flat vector styling. Render exactly one finished atlas image.
